component-o.description-s: High-performance MCU based on Arm Cortex-M55 core running up to 800 MHz (overdrive), with ST Neural-ART Accelerator NPU up to 1 GHz (600 Gops), Neo-Chrom 2.5D GPU, hardware H264 encoder and JPEG codec, ISP with parallel/2-lane CSI-2 camera interfaces, 4.2-Mbyte contiguous SRAM, no internal flash (boots from external XSPI/e.MMC/SD flash or serial USB/UART), embedded SMPS step-down converter providing VDDCORE. STM32N657Z0 variant: 75 I/Os, 5x SPI, 3x I2C, 2x I3C, 2x USART, 3x UART + LPUART, 2x USB 2.0 HS OTG (one with UCPD), Ethernet with TSN, 3x FDCAN, 2x SAI, 8-bit XSPI only, no SDMMC, dual 12-bit ADCs, security (TrustZone, AES, PKA, HASH, RNG). Packaged in VFBGA142 (8x8 mm, 0.5 mm pitch). Ambient operating temperature -40 to 125°C.
